messages:
lena: Need a quick plan for a POC with Nimbus. Customer asks for a scoped hosted API key for CI + demos, 48h TTL, IP allowlist and a documented rotation ceremony. Can we do that without a ticket for speed? CC @devin.

devin: We can mint 48h ephemeral tokens via the admin helper. No ticket required if it's under 72h and low scope. Need IPs and scopes.

lena: Scopes: generate, embeddings. IPs: 198.51.100.5, 198.51.100.6. POC is 7 days. They want autos rotation every 48h but also ability to manually rotate before live demo.

ashley: Security: ephemeral tokens <72h OK. Please capture customer SOC contact and confirm acceptance of ephemeral flow in the questionnaire. We'll set audit retention to 90 days for enterprise. Also require delivery via secure DM, not email.

ops-bot: /create_poc_token usage: `/create_poc_token <customer> <expiry_hours> <scopes> <ip_allowlist>`. Include metadata `poc/nimbus`. Admins only.

devin: Running: `/create_poc_token nimbus 48 generate,embeddings 198.51.100.5,198.51.100.6`

ops-bot: Token created (redacted). Expires in 48h. Audit id: audit-2145123456-01. Delivered via secure DM to lena and mark.

lena: Sending token to customer via 2FA DM and adding rotation runbook to the ticket. Contact: infra@nimbus.test.

mark: I'll add CI snippet to rotate env var and include cron for 48h rotation. Also will add a pre-demo checklist to rotate T-2h.

ashley: Please test revocation now as a dry run. Also record who performed revocation in the ticket.

devin: Revoking audit-2145123456-01 now.

ops-bot: Token audit-2145123456-01 revoked by devin.

devin: Verified 401 on calls. Reprovisioned audit-2145123456-02 with same scopes. Documented the step-by-step in the runbook (curl revocation and /create_poc_token examples).

lena: Great. Closing this thread. I'll upload questionnaire responses and the ticket id to CRM.
